description: The order and grouping in which tests run, generated by requirements-compiler v41: the v4 plan's bound tests, and v4.1's own contract, state-machine and unit tests (which are interface-conformance evidence, not plan obligations). Grouping shares an environment only: every test keeps its identity and its own assertions, every (obligation, test) binding of the plan is in exactly one suite, and no binding, category, P0, security, accessibility, WebKit, live GitHub, independent-acceptance or provenance test is removed. A suite's runner selects by namespace or folder, the same rule that assigns its tests.

environments.meaning: CI runner, no network beyond package restore
CI runner with Playwright Chromium and WebKit, the test build served locally
CI runner with the authorized GitHub test repository credential
the deployed candidate at the exact SHA and the GitHub test repository
a job or reviewer independent of the implementing agent
records in the run's Praxis event log

estimated.reason: v4 defines no run order or fixture plan to compare with, so no saving is claimed. Each suite reports the fixture set-ups its scope implies (counts.fixtureSetups); those are planning counts, not savings.

measured.reason: no event build has run against v4.1; the CI timings of the event build and the coordination telemetry (analysis/conflict-telemetry.json) will measure it
